cascades.label: Seasonal Fish
cascades.blurb: Rotates with the in-game season. Each is catchable only during its window before the next swaps in.

fish.name: Glass Ghost

challenges.name: Catch Summer Seasonal Local Legend: "Glass Ghost"

fish.description: Can only be caught at Glassed Cavern in the Cranberry Bog, and only while Summer is in season. Once the season turns, the Glass Ghost vanishes until next summer.

challenges.name: Catch Fall Seasonal Local Legend: "Sludge Eye"

cascades.blurb: Irradiated variants, one per region. A rare shimmer that rolls just below the legends.

cascades.label: Axolotl
cascades.blurb: Twelve colour morphs of the prize amphibian, one per calendar month. Only rolls on Improved or Superb bait.

cascades.label: Uncommon
cascades.blurb: Region signature fish, two per region. The middle of the cascade.

cascades.label: Common
cascades.blurb: One sawgill per region — the reliable everyday catch that fills most casts.

cascades.label: Generic
cascades.blurb: Plain fish found in any water. Bottom of the cascade, right before the junk.

cascades.label: Junk
cascades.blurb: Old-world rubbish snagged off the bottom — not a fish. No fight, no fillet.

cascades.label: Waterlogged Gifts
cascades.blurb: Weekend event drops. A 15% pre-cascade chance on each cast; open it for a reward bundle.
